প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ২৪ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪১৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৭ জুন, ২০১২ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh, through the Ministry of Finance, acts as the issuing authority for this regulatory notification.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the administrative body responsible for issuing customs and value-added tax related orders.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division acts as the specific government department under the Ministry of Finance that formalizes and publishes this customs and tax notification.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19 of the Act empowers the Government to amend customs notifications in the public interest and in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to issue notifications and amendments regarding tax adjustments.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the regulatory body consulted by the Government prior to issuing or amending customs and tax notifications.
S.R.O. 157-AIN/2011: This existing notification is amended to replace its entire table of goods with a new schedule of computer-related items.
Imported Machinery and Parts: The table provides a specific list of computer-related goods, including printers, toners, monitors, modems, and various storage media, classified under specific heading and H.S. codes for regulatory purposes.
